summary: UI-element constructor/initializer. Calls the shared base initializer ShortComputation_6d60(this, 1), then sets the vtable pointer to off_5A27C0 at this[0], stores a pointer to the global reference dword_7D02E4 at this[199] (offset 0x31C), writes the literal flag fields at this[201..204] (3/0/3/3) and value 270 at this[205] (0x334), and registers four text-handle nodes into the linked list: off_5BE704 followed by three copies of the "On" label handle aOn. Returns this.

operations.description: Call the shared base initializer ShortComputation_6d60(this, 1).
Set the vtable pointer at this[0] to &off_5A27C0.
Store the pointer to the global reference dword_7D02E4 at this[199] (offset 0x31C).
Write literal 3 to this[201] (0x324), 0 to this[202] (0x328), 3 to this[203] (0x32C) and 3 to this[204] (0x330).
Insert a linked-list node carrying the text handle &off_5BE704 via LinkedListInsertWithNodeAllocation(this, &off_5BE704, -1).
Insert a linked-list node carrying the "On" label handle via LinkedListInsertWithNodeAllocation(this, aOn, -1) (first of three).
Insert a second linked-list node carrying the "On" label handle via LinkedListInsertWithNodeAllocation(this, aOn, -1).
Insert a third linked-list node carrying the "On" label handle via LinkedListInsertWithNodeAllocation(this, aOn, -1).
